gainer_recall.why: mean recall 22% vs 25% bar; top-5 hit on 3/3 sessions

live_up_not_empty.why: flatten_robust sit=True on an audited UP window is a fail when leftover cash could buy 1 share (see sleeve today.json).

fat_day_keep_oc.why: 1/1 fat days: KEEP OC ≥ index OC − 0.50pp. C2C fat days are often the overnight gap; 09:30 longs only get the leftover OC. 2026-09-17 c2c=+1.14 gap=+1.05 idx_oc=+0.08 keep_oc=+5.49

overnight.rule: Find the bang *before* 09:30: buy D from the prior Finviz earnings calendar (AMC today / BMO next). Unfiltered liquid calendar is a coin flip. Mega-cap ($50B+) is the one-way slice. Index-like nights are yesterday's liquid winners (holdup / yday_gainer), not the earnings lottery. earn_react / e_fresh are after the print.

rules.title: Live book is in the market on UP mornings
rules.pass: On a session with morning S > 0, leftover cash ≥ $10k, and not hard-red: flatten_robust prints at least one live BUY (n_priced_buys ≥ 1 or a 09:30 ticket). io 3d must be able to schedule an exit (session calendar extends ≥ 3 sessions past D).
rules.fail: S positive and $101k leftover with 0 priced BUYs / `io 3d cannot settle` is a sit, not a strategy call.

rules.title: KEEP longs are not red from the 09:30 open on fat index days
rules.pass: On sessions with SPX close-to-close ≥ +0.80%: equal-weight open→close of that morning's KEEP long list (union_hot_n4_h1, else combo_sh longs) ≥ SPX open→close − 0.50 pp. Gap days are scored from the open, not from the prior close.
rules.fail: Thursday 09-17: SPX +1.14% close-to-close / +0.08% from the open; hot4 AZTA/RVTY/IT/FIVN −1.06% from the open.

rules.title: Liquid rippers show up on a morning list
rules.pass: Rolling 10 sessions: of each day's liquid top-15 (Change% ≥ 5%, mcap ≥ $100M, adv ≥ 500k), ≥ 25% are a hit, and ≥ 1 of the day's top-5 is a hit on at least 6 of those sessions. Hit = in stock-book 1d BUY ∪ flatten/KEEP tickets ∪ news |net| ≥ 1 ∪ a usable catalyst dossier.
rules.fail: Same-day Change% is the universe only. A name that ripped with every camera dark and no list seat is a miss.

rules.title: Dossier seats are real company events, not stuck override captains
rules.pass: Usable dossiers ≥ 2 that morning, the 8 targets are not identical for 3 straight sessions, and ≥ 1 target is in that day's news |net| ≥ 2 or that day's liquid top-15 gainers.
rules.fail: 09-16/17/18: same 8 oil/coal override captains (NE RIG SLB BKR KGS WHD CNR BTU), then OpenClaw+DeepSeek empty STEP1 → 0/8.
